chylaceous.m: Consisting of chyle or having the properties of chyle.

chyle.m: A milky fluid consisting of lymph and emulsified fats; formed in the small intestine during digestion of ingested fats.

chyles.m: A milky fluid consisting of lymph and emulsified fats; formed in the small intestine during digestion of ingested fats.

chylomicron.m: A microscopic particle of triglycerides produced in the intestines during digestion; in the bloodstream they release their fatty acids into the blood.

chylomicrons.m: A microscopic particle of triglycerides produced in the intestines during digestion; in the bloodstream they release their fatty acids into the blood.

chylous.m: Consisting of chyle or having the properties of chyle.

chyme.m: A semiliquid mass of partially digested food that passes from the stomach through the pyloric sphincter into the duodenum.

chymosin.m: An enzyme that occurs in gastric juice; causes milk to coagulate.

chymosins.m: An enzyme that occurs in gastric juice; causes milk to coagulate.
